content: flake-utils officially discouraged (NixOS wiki: use flake-parts instead). flake-parts is the module-system framework for flakes, used by nixpkgs itself and HM provides flakeModules.home-manager for it. For a small single-user multi-host repo, plain flake.nix with genAttrs/mkHost is simpler and avoids an extra input; flake-parts pays off when perSystem outputs, layered modules and many checks accumulate.
